name: cron_trial_expiry_alert
_description: Fase G+ - Cron diario 10:00 que escanea tenant_subscriptions con trial_ends_at en 7d/3d/1d via find_expiring_trials() y manda email al contact_email del tenant con link a Customer Portal. Idempotente: registra en trial_alerts_sent (UNIQUE tenant+alert_type+window_date) para NO spammear. Excluye tenants con plan_tier='founder'. Logs en activity_log.

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM find_expiring_trials() WHERE already_sent = false
INSERT INTO activity_log (project_id, agent_name, action, status, details) VALUES (NULL::uuid, 'cron_trial_expiry_alert', 'no_alerts_to_send', 'skipped', $1::jsonb)

INSERT INTO trial_alerts_sent (tenant_id, subscription_id, alert_type, alert_window_date, email_to, metadata) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::text, $4::date, $5::text, $6::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, alert_type, alert_window_date) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
